description: A valid provider session yields the expected subject, session, and active organization.
Local sign-out denial rejects an otherwise valid captured access token.
A verified revocation denial rejects an otherwise valid captured access token.
Switching organizations yields a token bound to the newly selected organization.
A token signed by an untrusted key is rejected.
A token from another issuer is rejected.
A token for another WorkOS client or Clerk authorized party is rejected.
An expired token is rejected after the configured clock tolerance.
A token whose not-before time is in the future is rejected.
A token whose issued-at time is in the future is rejected.
A token whose lifetime exceeds Tacit's admission policy is rejected.
A token without a subject is rejected.
A token without a session identifier is rejected.
A token without an active organization is rejected.
A token bound to one external organization cannot satisfy another organization request.
A configured rotated signing key verifies while an unknown key fails closed.
Two authenticated subjects with the same email do not link without independent account-control proof.
